description: Weekly (Monday 00-09, Berlin): minor, patch, pin and digest updates merge themselves once CI is green.
Majors wait for a person as draft PRs. TypeScript stays below 6 and @types/node below 25 on purpose.
Renovate merges by itself (platformAutomerge off), so it must be allowed to bypass the review rule on master.

packageRules.description: Merge without a person once the checks are green.
Workflow changes rerun everything; once a week in one PR.
WXT and its modules move together.
@hey-api/openapi-ts loads the TypeScript compiler API and breaks on TypeScript 6. Lift this once a release of openapi-ts supports it.
The engines field pins Node 24; the types follow the runtime, not the other way round.
Design tooling renders the mockups and store images locally. No CI covers it, so without ignoreTests no check would ever turn green.
Majors wait for a person, one draft PR each.
